name: Size Pass
displayDescription: Make any cart as tiny as a coffee cup or as huge as a small car: unlocks every cart size and wheel size from 40% to 160%, on every cart. Looks only: stats stay as at 70% and 130%.

name: Cart Paint
displayDescription: Every premium paint for your cart, yours to keep: 12 extra colors (Gold, Rose Gold, Silver, Jet Black, Hot Pink and more) and 9 finishes (Metal, Neon, Glass, Marble, Wood, Foil, Ice, Diamond Plate and Force Field). Signature carts keep their own look.

name: Custom Horns
displayDescription: Every horn in the game, yours to keep: Air Horn, Truck Horn, Train Horn, Clown Horn, Cartoon Honk, Duck Quack, Horse Neigh and La Cucaracha. New horns are included when they arrive. Honk at everyone on the way down.

name: VIP
displayDescription: The Golden Cart (earns x10 Scrap), the Rainbow trail and the Chrome Spikes wheels, all VIP exclusives. Every premium cart, trail, horn, crash effect and cart topper. A gold VIP nameplate and chat tag. +25% Scrap from every run.

name: Double Scrap
displayDescription: 2x Scrap from every run. Stacks with your cart's Scrap multiplier and with VIP (2.5x together).
